shots.title: Define a bounded focused roadmap context contract (#584)

hazards.description: Independent reconnaissance disagreed on successor semantics and exposed the context-free encoded-ID ambiguity; authored phase order and roadmap-aware labels were made explicit before implementation.

shots.notes: Added a versioned read model with full selected sprint, summary neighbors, phase contract, direct dependencies, bounded hazards/evidence, limits, and omission counts.

shots.title: Build deterministic focus projection from single-file roadmaps (#584)

hazards.description: Independent architecture/data reviews found terminal status flattening, missing performance hazards, encoded 435/43.5 completion/evidence mismatch, and evidence-cap eviction. The follow-up fixed all four and was independently approved.

shots.notes: The pure builder follows authored phase order, preserves terminal truth, computes readiness separately, maps legacy IDs with roadmap context, and projects only selected/dependency/recent scorecard hazards.

shots.title: Add slope roadmap focus --sprint with bounded human and JSON output (#584)
shots.notes: The CLI requires an explicit selector, supports decimal/encoded IDs and custom paths, keeps JSON stdout pure, scopes reality warnings to the selected sprint, and supplies canonical file evidence.

shots.title: Lock historical bounds and compatibility behavior (#584)

hazards.description: The first real SLOPE smoke exposed a 5 KB top-level roadmap description leaking historical narrative into otherwise bounded JSON; the projection now emits only the roadmap name.

shots.notes: Core/CLI/help/registry tests cover bounds, shuffled source order, direct dependencies, phase neighbors, JSON purity, invalid selectors, missing phases, custom paths, canonical S225, decimal IDs, and encoded S43.5 evidence.

conditions.description: The contract had to remain compatible with 131-sprint SLOPE history, a 455-sprint external repro, explicit decimal IDs, and legacy encoded half-sprint IDs.

training.description: Bound row counts do not guarantee bounded payloads when a retained field contains accumulated history.
training.outcome: Real-repository smoke checks now verify byte size and removed the global roadmap description from focused JSON.

training.description: Completion/readiness is computed state; superseded/cancelled/skipped is durable authored truth.
training.outcome: Focus preserves authored terminal status while representing operational readiness separately.

training.description: Legacy sprint-ID compatibility must cover labels, equality, ordering, scorecards, and evidence together.
training.outcome: Roadmap-aware identity equivalence now handles canonical S455 and encoded S43.5 end-to-end.

training.description: Evidence caps need priority rules or ancillary history can evict the selected sprint's canonical design records.
training.outcome: Roadmap source and selected sprint issue/design/artifact evidence are prioritized before ancillary scorecards.

nutrition.description: Focused compatibility suites passed, including 135 tests after independent-review repairs.
The complete Vitest suite passed after the initial implementation; repaired boundaries were then independently revalidated with focused suites and probes.
Typecheck and build passed, including packages/pi-extension.
Roadmap validation passed; required architecture and recommended data-contract reviews both approved after changes.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: The read model was straightforward; the hard part was defining what bounded, relevant, and compatible mean across fifteen months of roadmap history.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: Compile modular sources into this same RoadmapDefinition and keep focus completely source-agnostic.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: A single description string defeated row-level bounds, and encoded sprint compatibility failed independently at three identity surfaces.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: S229 can federate authoring sources without changing any focus consumers.

bunker_locations: Bounded projections must test byte size on a real accumulated-history repository, not only row counts in fixtures.
Preserve authored terminal statuses and compute readiness as a separate field.
Roadmap-aware sprint identity must normalize labels, equality, ordering, scorecard completion, and evidence paths together.
Prioritize selected-sprint evidence before applying global evidence caps.
Focused hazards should include only selected, direct-dependency, and bounded recent-phase scorecards.

src/core/roadmap.ts now exposes context-aware sprint ID formatting/ordering and typed roadmap metadata extensions.
src/cli/commands/roadmap.ts enriches focus with selected reality issues and canonical scorecard/review evidence.
slope roadmap focus --sprint=N supports bounded human output and deterministic --json output.
